overall_summary: Analysis of historical performance reveals a clear outlier in husband-wife relationship topics (my5mP9feI7s and or5gtaBpRVY achieving ~1,700 views, significantly outperforming family and general shayari videos). General poetry and niche emotional phrases have lower traction, proving that highly relatable, domestic partner dynamics drive engagement.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos focusing on married life ('Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?', 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए') gained 1,768 and 1,676 views respectively, vastly outperforming single-topic emotional shorts.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on marital and long-term relationship realities, focusing on unspoken domestic tensions.

winning_patterns.evidence: Titles using direct questions or statements about everyday partner behaviors ('Har Baar Sorry Bolne Wala...') performed steadily better than abstract poetic titles ('जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा...').
winning_patterns.action: Use conversational, direct-address framing in titles and hooks.

weak_patterns.pattern: Abstract Sad Shayari & Heavy Poetic Lines
weak_patterns.evidence: Titles like 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा… रिश्तों को षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा 💔' stalled at 19 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid overly dramatic, literary, or cynical poetry; keep the language grounded in daily reality.

weak_patterns.evidence: Duplicate sister-focused videos ('बहन सिर्फ घर की रौनक होती है') split views and performed poorly (19 and 138 views).
weak_patterns.action: Avoid repeating identical concepts within a short window; ensure distinct narrative angles.

next_video.twist_direction: The realization that when arguments stop, it doesn't mean love won; it means indifference has moved in.
next_video.reason: Matches the proven high-performing husband-wife relationship format while testing a slightly deeper emotional nuance to sustain watch time.

experiment: Testing if shifting from overt relationship conflict to subtle emotional distance in marriage retains the high view counts of previous relationship hits.
